description: This file defines extension methods for Memory<byte> and ReadOnlyMemory<byte> to retrieve underlying array segments, used for buffer manipulation within the Orleans networking shared namespace.

classes.name: BufferExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for Memory<byte> and ReadOnlyMemory<byte> to access underlying array segments.

methods.name: GetArray (Memory<byte>)
methods.description: Returns an ArraySegment<byte> from a Memory<byte> instance by casting it to ReadOnlyMemory<byte> and calling the other extension method.

methods.name: GetArray (ReadOnlyMemory<byte>)
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the underlying array segment from a ReadOnlyMemory<byte> using MemoryMarshal.TryGetArray; throws InvalidOperationException if not backed by an array.
